newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai's international trade up 9.8 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai's international trade up 9.8 pct in 1996.

text.p: Shanghai's international trade grew by 9.8 percent in value to $52.87 billion in 1996 with imports growing 13.9 percent to $25.66 billion, the Business News reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper said exports through Shanghai during the year were valued at $27.21 billion, up 6.3 percent.
The proportion of goods being shipped through Shanghai for processing and re-export continued to grow, amounting to $21.32 billion in 1996, a 15.6 percent increase over 1995.
